28/**
29 * @brief Combination of axis directions for a coordinate space convention.
30 *
31 * @details Each three-letter name gives the semantic direction of positive X,
32 * positive Y, and positive Z, respectively. For example, @ref CoordinateSpaceAxes::FLU
33 * means X-forward, Y-left, Z-up.
34 */
35enum class CoordinateSpaceAxes : uint16_t {
36 // Coordinate space conventions are composed of three of these directions for X, Y, and Z.
37 // These enumerators are not valid on their own.
38 Right,
39 Left,
40 Up,
41 Down,
42 Forward,
43 Backward,
44
45 // X=right/left, Y=up/down, Z=forward/backward.
46 RUF = Right << 0 | Up << 3 | Forward << 6,
47 RUB = Right << 0 | Up << 3 | Backward << 6,
48 RDF = Right << 0 | Down << 3 | Forward << 6,
49 RDB = Right << 0 | Down << 3 | Backward << 6,
50 LUF = Left << 0 | Up << 3 | Forward << 6,
51 LUB = Left << 0 | Up << 3 | Backward << 6,
52 LDF = Left << 0 | Down << 3 | Forward << 6,
53 LDB = Left << 0 | Down << 3 | Backward << 6,
54
55 // X=right/left, Y=forward/backward, Z=up/down.
56 RFU = Right << 0 | Forward << 3 | Up << 6,
57 RFD = Right << 0 | Forward << 3 | Down << 6,
58 RBU = Right << 0 | Backward << 3 | Up << 6,
59 RBD = Right << 0 | Backward << 3 | Down << 6,
60 LFU = Left << 0 | Forward << 3 | Up << 6,
61 LFD = Left << 0 | Forward << 3 | Down << 6,
62 LBU = Left << 0 | Backward << 3 | Up << 6,
63 LBD = Left << 0 | Backward << 3 | Down << 6,
64
65 // X=up/down, Y=right/left, Z=forward/backward.
66 URF = Up << 0 | Right << 3 | Forward << 6,
67 URB = Up << 0 | Right << 3 | Backward << 6,
68 ULF = Up << 0 | Left << 3 | Forward << 6,
69 ULB = Up << 0 | Left << 3 | Backward << 6,
70 DRF = Down << 0 | Right << 3 | Forward << 6,
71 DRB = Down << 0 | Right << 3 | Backward << 6,
72 DLF = Down << 0 | Left << 3 | Forward << 6,
73 DLB = Down << 0 | Left << 3 | Backward << 6,
74
75 // X=up/down, Y=forward/backward, Z=right/left.
76 UFR = Up << 0 | Forward << 3 | Right << 6,
77 UFL = Up << 0 | Forward << 3 | Left << 6,
78 UBR = Up << 0 | Backward << 3 | Right << 6,
79 UBL = Up << 0 | Backward << 3 | Left << 6,
80 DFR = Down << 0 | Forward << 3 | Right << 6,
81 DFL = Down << 0 | Forward << 3 | Left << 6,
82 DBR = Down << 0 | Backward << 3 | Right << 6,
83 DBL = Down << 0 | Backward << 3 | Left << 6,
84
85 // X=forward/backward, Y=right/left, Z=up/down.
86 FRU = Forward << 0 | Right << 3 | Up << 6,
87 FRD = Forward << 0 | Right << 3 | Down << 6,
88 FLU = Forward << 0 | Left << 3 | Up << 6,
89 FLD = Forward << 0 | Left << 3 | Down << 6,
90 BRU = Backward << 0 | Right << 3 | Up << 6,
91 BRD = Backward << 0 | Right << 3 | Down << 6,
92 BLU = Backward << 0 | Left << 3 | Up << 6,
93 BLD = Backward << 0 | Left << 3 | Down << 6,
94
95 // X=forward/backward, Y=up/down, Z=right/left.
96 FUR = Forward << 0 | Up << 3 | Right << 6,
97 FUL = Forward << 0 | Up << 3 | Left << 6,
98 FDR = Forward << 0 | Down << 3 | Right << 6,
99 FDL = Forward << 0 | Down << 3 | Left << 6,
100 BUR = Backward << 0 | Up << 3 | Right << 6,
101 BUL = Backward << 0 | Up << 3 | Left << 6,
102 BDR = Backward << 0 | Down << 3 | Right << 6,
103 BDL = Backward << 0 | Down << 3 | Left << 6,
104
105 // Default convention for Mochi
106 Default = FLU,
107};

164/** @brief Coordinate-axis convention and linear unit scale. */
165struct CoordinateSpace {
166 CoordinateSpaceAxes axes = CoordinateSpaceAxes::Default;
167
168 // Always double precision for precision-independent debugger protocol.
169 double unitsPerMeter = 1.0;
170
171 constexpr CoordinateSpace() = default;
172 constexpr CoordinateSpace(CoordinateSpaceAxes inAxes, double inUnitsPerMeter)
173 : axes(inAxes), unitsPerMeter(inUnitsPerMeter) {}
174
175 /**
176 * @brief Validate that @ref axes is a complete convention and
177 * @ref unitsPerMeter is finite and positive.
178 */
179 void Validate(Error& error) const;
180
181 /** @brief Return the unit vector pointing right, in this space's own coordinates. */
182 [[nodiscard]] Real3 GetRight() const;
183
184 /** @brief Return the unit vector pointing up, in this space's own coordinates. */
185 [[nodiscard]] Real3 GetUp() const;
186
187 /** @brief Return the unit vector pointing forward, in this space's own coordinates. */
188 [[nodiscard]] Real3 GetForward() const;
189
190 /** @brief Return the default coordinate space convention for Mochi. */
191 [[nodiscard]] static CoordinateSpace Default() {
192 return {CoordinateSpaceAxes::Default, 1.0};
193 }
194
195 /** @brief Return the coordinate space convention for Filament. */
196 [[nodiscard]] static CoordinateSpace Filament() {
197 return {CoordinateSpaceAxes::RUB, 1.0};
198 }
199
200 /** @brief Return the coordinate space convention for OpenGL. */
201 [[nodiscard]] static CoordinateSpace OpenGL() {
202 return {CoordinateSpaceAxes::RUB, 1.0};
203 }
204
205 /** @brief Return the coordinate space convention for ROS */
206 [[nodiscard]] static CoordinateSpace ROS() {
207 return {CoordinateSpaceAxes::FLU, 1.0}; // Same as Default
208 }
209
210 /** @brief Return the coordinate space convention for Unity. */
211 [[nodiscard]] static CoordinateSpace Unity() {
212 return {CoordinateSpaceAxes::RUF, 1.0};
213 }
214
215 /** @brief Return the coordinate space convention for Unreal Engine. */
216 [[nodiscard]] static CoordinateSpace Unreal() {
217 return {CoordinateSpaceAxes::FRU, 100.0};
218 }
219
220#if MOCHI_LANGUAGE_CPP20
221 constexpr bool operator==(CoordinateSpace const& rhs) const = default;
222 constexpr bool operator!=(CoordinateSpace const& rhs) const = default;
223#endif
224
225 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::CoordinateSpace)
226 MOCHI_FIELD(axes)
227 MOCHI_FIELD(unitsPerMeter)
228 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
229};
